units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 29a:11">Ab. Zar. 29ᵃ</cite> (to one that entrusted himself to a gentile barber) <he>יאי קוֹעָיךְ לזוגא</he> thou hast a fine neck for the shears.

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 117a:18">B. Kam. 117ᵃ</cite> <he>שמטיה לקוֹעֵיה מיניה</he> tore his windpipe out of him (a colloquial expression for: forced him to give up the threatened information against his neighbor; differ. in Rashi).

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 55a:10">Ib. 55ᵃ</cite> <he>אריך קועיה</he> (Ms. H. <he>קַאֲק׳</he>, emended <he>קַעְק׳</he>; Ar. <he>קַקֵּיה</he>; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 200) has a long neck, <he>זוטר ק׳</he> a short neck.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 55a:10">Ib.</cite> <he>אלים קועיה</he> (Ms. M. <he>קאקיה</he>) has a thick neck; <he>קטין ק׳</he> slender neck.
<cite ref="Berakhot 49a:15">Ber. 49ᵃ</cite> <he>זקפיה … לקועיה וכ׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>מתחיה … לצוארי׳</he>) R. Shesheth stretched his neck over me like a serpent (was angry).

<cite ref="Yoma 87a:16">Yoma 87ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>בהדי דקא … מחייה בקועיה וקטליה</he> (not <he>בקועייה</he>) while he was splitting a head, a bone flew off and struck his throat (severing an artery), and killed him; a. e.—[<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 111:15">Yalk. Gen. 111</cite> <he>קועי׳</he>, v. <cite ref="M02400"><he>מַקּוֹרָא</he></cite>.]
